stage0099_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$シモン$$
（It's like being buried in the earth...）

stage0099_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$シモン$$
（We... and the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$...）

stage0099_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$カミナ$$
「What are you doing, $$シモン$$?」

stage0099_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$カミナ$$
「Told you leaving Jiha Village was the right call, huh?
　We can't beat the Beastmen, but slip past their eyes
　and grab what's valuable, we can do as we please!」

stage0099_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$カミナ$$
「You open the safe with your drill, and I'll grab it!
　Count on you, brother!」

stage0099_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$カミナ$$
「Now, let's get moving!
　Time we made a big score in the city!」

stage0099_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text: $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ Home Base

stage0099_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text: $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ Home Base

stage0099_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text: $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ Home Base

stage0099_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「It's pointless to hope for anything from that man of the Spiral」

stage0099_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Everyone who came to save you
　is trapped in the multiversal labyrinth」

stage0099_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「The multiverse...
　It is the branching of possibilities.
　Within it, they are trapped in a dream they cannot wake from」

stage0099_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「A possibility of what might have been...
　Some are convenient dreams, others nightmares」

stage0099_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「As long as an intellect exists that can perceive
　possibility, there is no escaping it.
　Nor will Spiral power ever awaken there」

stage0099_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ニア$$
「...I believe...
　that $$シモン$$... that everyone will surely
　build a new tomorrow...!」

stage0099_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「...The war with the Spiral race is futile...
　No matter how much absolute despair we deal,
　another fool rises in some corner of some universe」

stage0099_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「We too have grown weary of it...
　But Irregular... if we can analyze the resistance
　factor within you, their total annihilation becomes possible」

stage0099_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Then their interference will end,
　and true peace will come to the universe...」

stage0099_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「I'll be reading your information...」

stage0099_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$美重子$$
「Yes, Takeo.
　I made sure this test came out perfect too」

stage0099_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Huh... what do you mean, 'made sure'...?」

stage0099_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$美重子$$
「As long as you write your name, it's fine.
　You're the heir to Takeo General Company,
　the worldwide conglomerate, after all」

stage0099_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$美重子$$
「Don't worry about tests from now on either.
　No, it's not just that...」

stage0099_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$美重子$$
「Going on to school, finding a job, all of it,
　your father will see to everything」

stage0099_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$美重子$$
「What's wrong, Takeo?
　Using such vulgar language...」

stage0099_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm the President's son, an elementary schooler...」

stage0099_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Look, $$正太郎$$!
　Those middle schoolers... they're bullying a kitten!」

stage0099_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$マッキー$$
「But if they're middle schoolers, there's nothing we can do」

stage0099_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Come on, let's go.
　If we keep staring, those guys will come over here」

stage0099_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$敷島$$
「It's all right, $$正太郎$$.
　You don't need to fight.
　You're just an elementary schooler, after all」

stage0099_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$マッキー$$
「That's right, $$正太郎$$.
　Let's play tennis at my place!」

stage0099_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Yeah, that's right...
　I'm just a kid, with no power at all...」

stage0099_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「What are you doing, $$キリコ$$?
　The match is about to start」

stage0099_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「It's $$バトリング$$.
　Win for me again today, $$キリコ$$」

stage0099_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$矢三郎$$
「As expected of you, $$アルト$$.
　You truly live up to the Musashiya name」

stage0099_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$矢三郎$$
「With this, the Saotome school is secure.
　Born into a family of the art,
　it was your destiny to master its way」

stage0099_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アルト$$
（My dance... my wings...
　This is where I belong...）

stage0099_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$矢三郎$$
「After that, once you, $$アルト$$,
　marry the young lady Master Arashizou
　has arranged, there'll be nothing left to worry about」

stage0099_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$矢三郎$$
「Now then, $$アルト$$...
　For the sake of the Saotome school too, please accept the match」

stage0099_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Grandpa and $$シロー$$ are in the bath.
　Go wash off your sweat too」

stage0099_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$つばさ$$
「What's wrong, you strange child.
　Is something on Mom's face?」

stage0099_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Once your father's home, let's have dinner.
　It's a feast today」

stage0099_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ナナリー$$
「What are you gonna do after you graduate, bro?」

stage0099_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ナナリー$$
「You've got looks and brains,
　so I bet you'd do fine at anything, bro」

stage0099_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ナナリー$$
「Don't worry about me, okay.
　$$スザク$$'s got my back, I can manage to get by」

stage0099_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ナナリー$$
「Enjoy life more.
　You're free, bro」

stage0099_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What, you could just call her by name like usual」

stage0099_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Hey, $$テッサ$$!
　Stay away from my $$宗介$$!」

stage0099_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Oh my, Sagara is mine.
　He's not fit for a stray cat like you」

stage0099_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What's wrong, $$宗介$$?
　You'll be late at this rate」

stage0099_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$カズミ$$
「What's wrong, $$ノリコ$$?
　Giving up already?」

stage0099_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$カズミ$$
「Heh heh... Seems you've still got some guts left.
　In that case... twenty more laps around the field...
　Would that be all right?」

stage0099_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$カズミ$$
「You're more energetic than usual today」

stage0099_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Because...!
　Because Big Sis is with me!」

stage0099_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Ah... that's the first time you've called me by name...」

stage0099_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Heh heh... You two seem close this morning」

stage0099_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Come on, Ayanami.
　Don't tease me」

stage0099_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「What's wrong, $$シンジ$$?
　Your face is red」

stage0099_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「You're not calling me $$レイ#333$$... like you always do」

stage0099_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$オルソン#50$$
「Stop it, $$桂$$.
　If we go through with the $$時空修復$$, you'll never see Mimsy again」

stage0099_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$オルソン#50$$
「I chose to live my life with Athena.
　So this world can stay just the way it is」

stage0099_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$オルソン#50$$
「Who cares what role the singularity has to play.
　We should just live the way we want to」

stage0099_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$マーグ#pilot$$
「So this is it, Crusher Team's base, the key to Earth's defense」

stage0099_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$マーグ#pilot$$
「Let's go, Mars.
　We'll infiltrate that facility and sabotage it from within」

stage0099_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$マーグ#pilot$$
「What's wrong, Mars?
　We must carry out our duty
　as Emperor $$ズール$$'s loyal soldiers」

stage0099_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$マーグ#pilot$$
「Emperor $$ズール$$ is justice itself.
　Don't you forget that」

stage0099_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$パプテマス・シロッコ$$!」

stage0099_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$シロッコ$$
「I'll take your heart along with me too...!
　$$カミーユ・ビダン$$!」

stage0099_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$シャア$$
「And yet, it's people with this very warmth
　who go on to destroy even Earth!」

stage0099_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's what you need to understand, $$アムロ$$!」

stage0099_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I know that!
　That's why we have to show the world
　the light of the human heart, isn't it!」

stage0099_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$シャア$$
「Heh... for a man like that,
　you were awfully cold to $$クェス$$!」

stage0099_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm not a machine!
　I can't be a father figure to $$クェス$$!」

stage0099_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Is that why!?
　You treated $$クェス$$ like a machine...」

stage0099_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$シャア$$
「I see...!
　$$クェス$$ wanted a father!」

stage0099_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$シャア$$
「And so... I found that a burden,
　and turned $$クェス$$ into a machine」

stage0099_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「A man like you, acting so small-minded!」

stage0099_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$ララァ・スン$$ was a woman
　who might have become my mother!
　Is that something you can say, you who killed $$ララァ$$!」

stage0099_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$キラ$$
「The world is crying right now!!」

stage0099_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$シン$$
「Just who the hell are youuuuu!!」

stage0099_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$...
　It's impossible for you」

stage0099_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「I am $$ミネバ$$ Zabi.
　I'm from a world different from yours」

stage0099_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$弁慶$$
「It's the least mercy we can offer...
　We'll finish you off ourselves」

stage0099_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$$隼人$$, $$弁慶$$! What the hell is this!?」

stage0099_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$隼人$$
「$$竜馬$$... Your very existence is an enemy to mankind」

stage0099_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$弁慶$$
「If only you didn't exist, peace would come to mankind!」

stage0099_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$隼人$$
「Die! You who were chosen by the Getter rays!」

stage0099_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I'm the only one who needs to be $$アポロン$$'s reincarnation!
　You can disappear!!」

stage0099_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$葵$$
「...There's no one here...
　I've... always been alone...」

stage0099_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Mountain!
　Today, I'll get you moving!」

stage0099_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$バサラ$$
「My... my song!
　Listen! Please, listen to meeee!!」

stage0099_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$青山$$
「$$赤木$$...
　Did you make your quota?」

stage0099_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$赤木$$
「Quota...? What are you talking about, $$青山$$?」

stage0099_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$青山$$
「Think about your position.
　Even if we started the same year,
　I'm your superior now」

stage0099_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$青山$$
「...Listen...
　I know you don't want to admit you're
　a perpetual deadweight, but enough already」

stage0099_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$青山$$
「$$いぶき$$ was worried about you too」

stage0099_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$青山$$
「Got a problem with someone's wife?」

stage0099_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$青山$$
「There's no more $$ヘテロダイン$$ left now.
　You should get your feet on the ground
　and live like it, too」

stage0099_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What are you doing, $n.
　Still not done with your assignment?」

stage0099_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's too familiar.
　Call me Miss Saijou properly」

stage0099_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Or is it that you... want my private lesson?」

stage0099_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text: $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ Home Base

stage0099_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text: $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ Home Base

stage0099_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text: $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ Home Base

stage0099_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「...Some are steeped in the future they dreamed of,
　others wander through the worst that could have been,
　and others taste death, over and over」

stage0099_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「For those trapped within the
　multiversal labyrinth, escape is impossible」

stage0099_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Hoh... so someone has set foot in here」

stage0099_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$不動$$
「It's nothing to be surprised at」

stage0099_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Time, distance... not even dimension
　matters, not before what someone
　truly feels」

stage0099_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「...What did you come here for.
　Are you trying to say that you've
　rightly evolved?」

stage0099_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$不動$$
「...If it ends here, then that's as far as they got」

stage0099_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「I see.
　It does seem you're one who's achieved
　a true evolution」

stage0099_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$カヲル$$
「I understand how you feel too.
　But...」

stage0099_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Don't talk like you understand...!」

stage0099_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$不動$$
「But they'll walk the right path,
　even without anyone's help」

stage0099_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$不動$$
「From among countless possibilities,
　they affirm the present, and advance
　down the path that leads to the future...」

stage0099_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「It's futile.
　It's already over」

stage0099_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「The multiversal labyrinth converges
　on the horizon of causality.
　This is the end」

stage0099_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「...Why?
　Why won't it end...!?」

stage0099_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Can't you believe it, sorrowful guardian of the universe」

stage0099_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「The god of light from Olympus!」

stage0099_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$ニア$$
「That answer is because
　they're still trying to move forward」

stage0099_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「...Why?
　Why won't it end...!?」

stage0099_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ニア$$
「That answer is because
　they're still trying to move forward」

stage0099_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
Beastman
「You little punks!
　You had some nerve, pulling a bold
　stunt like safecracking!」

stage0099_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$カミナ$$
「Sorry! We're sorry!
　Forgive us! C'mon! Look, we're begging!
　Have mercy! It was our fault!」

stage0099_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$カミナ$$
「We'll do whatever you say!
　If bowing's what it takes, we'll bow
　as much as you want! Sorry! Sorry! Sorry!」

stage0099_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$カミナ$$
「So just, our lives! Spare our lives,
　at least! Sorry! We're sorry!
　Forgive us!」

stage0099_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$カミナ$$
「Did you lose it? The drill?」

stage0099_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$カミナ$$
「Dai-Gurren Brigade, infamous in Jiha Village!
　Bearing a man's soul upon our backs!
　Unbending, unyielding! Ah! The demon leader!」

stage0099_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$カミナ$$
「As if there'd be more than one
　great $$カミナ$$ running around!!」

stage0099_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$シモン$$
「Ah, no! But there's two of you...!」

stage0099_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$カミナ$$
「That's right! Pick whichever one you like!」

stage0099_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$カミナ$$
「Did you forget?
　It's you who gave substance to my
　recklessness, to me pushing forward!」

stage0099_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$カミナ$$
「Your drill's not supposed to be like
　some pebble lying on the ground!
　Your drill is right here!」

stage0099_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$カミナ$$
「Don't just keep lazing around here
　forever! What's your drill even for?」

stage0099_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$カミナ$$
「Hey, $$シモン$$! What are you doing!」

stage0099_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$カミナ$$
「You bow your head too! Bow! Bow!
　Play dumb, fake an apology, get through
　this! Keep your head down and ride it out!」

stage0099_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$カミナ$$
「Keep your head down and apologize!」

stage0099_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$シモン$$
「My driiill! It's the drill that
　pierces the heaaavens!!」

stage0099_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$カミナ$$
「Go, $$シモン$$.
　Don't let yourself be swayed by thoughts
　like 'what if,' 'if only,' or 'should have'」

stage0099_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$カミナ$$
「The one thing you chose yourself,
　that's the truth of your universe」

stage0099_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah, that's right...
　That's exactly right」

stage0099_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$キタン$$
「Hey now... don't go forgetting about me too」

stage0099_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$キタン$$
「It's $$キタン$$ of the Black Siblings!
　Did you forget again, you!?」

stage0099_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$カミナ$$
「Heh... Baaaka!
　Like hell I'd forget!」

stage0099_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$カミナ$$
「Like I'd ever forget...
　you guys, I mean」

stage0099_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$カミナ$$
「Seems like everyone's chosen this path」

stage0099_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Of course!
　I'm happy Dad's alive, but if they call
　me 'young master,' my back gets itchy!」

stage0099_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I will fight.
　Even without $$鉄人$$, with my own strength」

stage0099_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$タケル$$
「We should be able to choose the right
　path ourselves, and change our fate」

stage0099_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I won't choose a fate someone else gave me」

stage0099_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$桂$$
「That's right.
　Whatever the result, I'll grab my own
　future with my own hands」

stage0099_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Someone important to me taught me.
　That it's not an illusion, not just
　consciousness, but the fact that I'm alive」

stage0099_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「People should be able to correct
　their mistakes and break free from
　the cycle of tragedy」

stage0099_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「The world doesn't run on some
　three-step rhythm of war, peace,
　and revolution」

stage0099_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$シン$$
「If we try to understand each other...」

stage0099_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$刹那$$
「We can come to understand one another」

stage0099_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That is possibility... hope for the future」

stage0099_03:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$葵$$
「I'm not alone.
　I have friends walking the same path」

stage0099_03:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Our souls move mountains and shake dimensions!」

stage0099_03:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$アルト$$
「As long as there's someone important...
　something worth protecting, we'll fly」

stage0099_03:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$甲児$$
「Victory lies beyond the light of hope!
　We're moving straight toward it!」

stage0099_03:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Anyone who gets in my way,
　I'll blast away. Even if my opponent
　is myself」

stage0099_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's it! No matter what the world
　or society says, isn't it fine to have
　a salaryman out there protecting peace!」

stage0099_03:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「If you take pride in your own duty,
　then that alone is the right thing to do」

stage0099_03:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「That's right.
　We can decide for ourselves what is right」

stage0099_03:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem.
　I know what needs to be done」

stage0099_03:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$アマタ$$
「To protect the ones I treasure and the world I love」

stage0099_03:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$カグラ$$
「By joining forces with my comrades!」

stage0099_03:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Never leaning on anyone, never giving up, never losing...!
　That's how we fight」

stage0099_03:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$カミナ$$
「...Before I knew it, you outgrew me」

stage0099_03:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Peaceful days spent with someone I love...
　I was having a sweet dream...」

stage0099_03:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「But a dream is just a dream.
　I'll fight... as the soul you and $$シモン$$ taught me commands!」

stage0099_03:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$カミナ$$
「Yeah! You guys give it your all too!」

stage0099_03:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$カミナ$$
「Yeah! This time it really is goodbye!
　Go on, brother!」

stage0099_03:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$シモン$$
「Don't say goodbye!
　We're always together, aren't we?」

stage0099_03:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text: $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ Home Base

stage0099_03:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text: $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ Home Base

stage0099_03:r_2249da179abb6501.text: $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ Home Base

stage0099_03:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「What is the meaning of this...
　Why hasn't the Multiversal Labyrinth disappeared?」

stage0099_03:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Then, Irregular...!
　I'll analyze you and find the answer!」

stage0099_03:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$ニア$$
「No matter how much you examine my body,
　you as you are now cannot defeat them.
　He will come...! Without fail...!!」

stage0099_03:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$ニア$$
「As long as I hold on to these feelings!」

stage0099_03:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$シモン$$
「I'm here, $$ニア$$!
　Just like I promised!!」

stage0099_03:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「No way...!
　There's no way intelligent life could
　escape the Multiversal Labyrinth...!」

stage0099_03:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$シモン$$
「Don't mess with us!
　Time, space, the multiverse, I don't care which!
　None of that matters to us!」

stage0099_03:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$シモン$$
「We carve out our own path, our own way, and push it through!
　That's who we are, $c!!」

stage0099_03:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$!
　I'm getting $$ニア$$ back!!」

stage0099_03:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, everyone.
　I'd say you've cleared the first stage」

stage0099_03:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「While I commend everyone's hard-fought struggle,
　allow me to also send you cheers for the battles ahead」

stage0099_03:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For now, though, the real thing will begin
　once the Prison of Time is completely destroyed...」

stage0099_03:r_1a9f38456bfe7b4a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then!
　Let's stay fired up, business, business!
　Today's the last sale!」
